sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Catch the Fly are simple yet effective. Players are tasked with catching a pesky fly that is flying around the screen. To do this, players must use a variety of tools such as a net, a swat, or a vacuum to catch the fly. The tools can be upgraded as players progress through the game, allowing for more effective catching and higher scores.

One of the key mechanics that makes Catch the Fly so engaging is the fly's erratic flight pattern. The fly will fly around the screen in a random pattern, making it challenging for players to catch. However, the fly's behavior is also predictable, allowing players to develop strategies for catching it. For example, players can use the net to catch the fly when it is flying in a straight line, or use the swat to catch it when it is flying erratically.

The game also features a variety of obstacles that players must navigate around. These obstacles can include other objects on the screen, such as rocks or trees, or even other flies that are flying around. Players must use their skills and strategy to avoid these obstacles and catch the fly.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Catch the Fly are engaging and challenging, making it a great choice for players who love arcade games.
